name: gnox
description: One namespace for every skill in the gnomatix-oss-skills marketplace (/gnox:<plugin> and /gnox:<plugin>:<skill>), plus session-start and post-compact hooks that establish the GNOMATIX Namespacing Convention (workspace_root:subdir:... hierarchical scoping, [NS]{@target} CLI-safe callouts, and «term» [CURIE] grounding) across the user's working session.
